patch.value: GH-832: package command namespace ownership and collision diagnostics are not discoverable
Track the public-package collision with the bundled private pm-vcs exemplar and define deterministic, inspectable command namespace ownership for extension authors and operators.

Expose command-path and alias ownership through SDK and contracts; fail closed or resolve collisions by a documented deterministic policy naming all claimants; report collisions in health; namespace bundled exemplars without breaking existing invocations; cover scope-preserving package identity and dual-package activation
Package authors can preflight command and alias ownership, activation resolves collisions deterministically, and diagnostics name every claimant without silently dropping sibling commands.
A private bundled exemplar and a public package independently claim vcs aliases and command paths; fresh workspaces cannot discover ownership or the collision outcome.
